'''Gladean''' was the [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of the [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrilan]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Emita/Legends|Emita]] thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He passed a law that created the [[Gladean State Parks]].<ref name="Strongholds">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>
